subject: Mathematics
question_text: Let a₁, a₂, a₃, … be an A.P. and g₁ = a₁, g₂, g₃, … be an increasing G.P. If a₁ = a₂ + g₂ = 1 and a₃ + g₃ = 4, then a₁₀ + g₅ is equal to:
solution: From a₁=1 and a₂+g₂=1, with a₂=1+d and g₂=r, obtain d+r=0, so d=−r. The condition a₃+g₃=4 gives (1+2d)+r²=4, hence (r−1)²=4. Since the G.P. is increasing and starts at 1, r=3 (not −1), so d=−3. Then a₁₀=1+9(−3)=−26 and g₅=3⁴=81; their sum is 55, option D.
